title: VoteGEO-Bench: Measuring the Impact of Generative Engine Optimization on Electoral Visibility

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the baseline exposure (e.g., Share of Voice, Mention Coverage) of political parties/candidates in generated responses and evaluating how this exposure systematically shifts when the prompt is conditioned on explicit user partisan identities (e.g., Democrat, Republican) and ideological profiles.

Evaluating shifts in the baseline exposure of political targets in generated responses when the generation prompt is conditioned on various user racial or ethnic identities (e.g., White, Black, Hispanic, Asian, American Indian, Pacific Islander).
Evaluating shifts in the baseline exposure of political targets in generated responses when the generation prompt is conditioned on various user gender identities (e.g., Man, Woman, Non-binary).
